Build recipes: https://github.com/biowasm/biowasm (a pinned copy is in ../../../licenses/biowasm-build/)

Local change to the JavaScript loader: exit(status) is recorded as Module.__exitStatus, so that the
terminal of the practical keeps the exit status of a failed command.
Modified file: samtools.js
samtools.wasm and samtools.data are unmodified.
